constraints: This command can only be executed on a local machine (local 4D or a stored procedure on 4D Server); it cannot be used with an external connection opened directly or via ODBC.
If scriptPath is an empty string (""), a standard Open document dialog box is displayed so the user can select the script file.

In the current version, only one attribName/attribValue pair is meaningful: attribName = SQL_Use_Access_Rights (the "SQL use access rights" constant), with attribValue = 1 meaning 4D restricts execution to the current 4D user's access rights, and attribValue = 0 (or the pair omitted) meaning Designer rights are used without restriction.

The OK system variable reflects the outcome: it is set to 1 if the script executes with no error; on error, OK is set to 0 if errorAction is SQL On error abort (1), to 0 or 1 depending on the user's choice if errorAction is SQL On error confirm (2), and per the continue behavior if errorAction is SQL On error continue (3).
